text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hello there!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan and Dia
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for joining us for our first shrine
visit of
the year!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No one has greater hopes for the year
than these
two. The three of us head to
the shrine to make
our New Year's
wishes.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I need to be at my strongest by the time
the
Arima Kinen rolls around at the end
of the year,
or else I'll never beat Dia...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
So Trainer, do you think we could talk
strategy
before I pray for extra support?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before we decide Kitasan Black's racing
agenda,
though, we first need to
establish what we feel
sets her apart.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But... that's what we figured out last
year, isn't it?
There's nothing in
particular that sets me apart
from the
others.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
My acceleration is average, my race
performance
isn't eye-catching, and I
don't possess any
promise as a star... But
still!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I do my best and hold out to the very
end of
every race I run! Doing so has
allowed me to
slowly improve and gain
more supporters.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
If that's what I have going on for me,
then let's
see...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just then, I have a thought. If her
performance
itself won't draw others in...
then we'll just have to
play the numbers
game instead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black's strength lies in her
unparalleled
toughness. If we want to
take advantage of that,
then I know just
what to do this spring.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Seriously?! All three of them?! But
they're all huge
races that are
medium-distance or longer!
choice_data_list_en: Let's enter all three Spring G1 races!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she performs well in these three races,
people's
expectations for her will no
doubt rise.
choice_data_list: ああ、大阪杯、天皇賞（春）、宝塚記念だ
うん、大阪杯、天皇賞（春）、宝塚記念！
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, the Osaka Hai, Tenno Sho (Spring), and Takarazuka Kinen.
Yeah, the Osaka Hai, Tenno Sho (Spring), and Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I definitely think that would help...
but it's
not enough!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Can I run even more after those three?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
If we're going to do back-to-back races,
I want to
keep up the momentum until
my run with Dia in
the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
After the Takarazuka Kinen, I want to
take on the
autumn Tenno Sho and
Japan Cup before diving
into the Arima
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Could we please do six G1 races in a
row? I know
this schedule is beyond
reckless, but please!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It'll be tough brute-forcing through so
many races
in one year, but if there's
anyone who can handle
that schedule
and more, it's Kitasan Black.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Our first race is gonna be the Osaka Hai,
huh?
And afterwards, if I manage to do
well at the
spring Tenno Sho...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I might be able to rank higher in the
Takarazuka
Kinen's popularity poll. It'd
be nice to rank higher
than third, like I
did in last year's Arima...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: You want me to try to become the most popular Umamusume?
choice_data_list_en: No, our goal is first place!
No, our goal is first place!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's no turning back here. We have
to prove
that she can be everyone's
favorite even without
any innate
showiness.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You're right... Let's aim for first! I'm
going to
become the best and most
popular Umamusume
around! And once I
do...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'll be a big shot in title and skill, just like my dad!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, this year's schedule is set and
Kitasan
Black's wish takes on a more
tangible form.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It looks like you've made up your mind,
Kita.
Come on then, let's go and pray!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Okay!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I wish to run well in all six consecutive
G1 races in
my senior year and to put
smiles on everyone's
faces!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I wish to conquer a G1 race! May I fulfill
my
dearest wish and illuminate everyone
with my
brilliant light as a Satono!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One wish bursts up from the earth while
the other
shines down from the heavens.
Though their
wishes take very different
forms...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their feelings are the same. They both
want to do
their best as Umamusume to
give back to their
loved ones...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan and Dia
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, our first shrine visit of the new
year
finishes up without a hitch.
choice_data_list_en: Let's give our best to both.
Let's give our best to both.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
All right, Dia. You know what time it is!
Let's get
started on our annual New Year
showdown!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. But what should we do
this time?
We'll be running in the Arima
Kinen at the end of
the year, so we
should do it before that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It appears that having some kind of
competition
at the start of every new
year has become a
tradition for the two
of them.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You know, we do have a third person
here who
can help us out. Why don't we
ask your trainer
what we should compete
in?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Good idea! Hey, Trainer, pick something
we can
really go all out in!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It would be boring if I just suggested
they race
each other, so I try to think of
something with a
New Year's flair.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, fukuwarai! That's the game where
you try to
put facial features on a blank
face while
blindfolded, right? Let's play
it at my house, Dia!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we head over to Kitasan Black's
family
home.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... I think the eyes should go
here! And I'll
put the nose around here!
How'd I do?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! What in the world is this face,
Kita?
Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
How did you manage to make it look so
hilarious?
It's not fair!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I-is it really that funny? You're laughing
so hard
at it, Dia...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Pfft! Ahahaha! You've got me laughing
too!
Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two roll around on the floor in fits of

laughter. Playing fukuwarai was clearly a
great
decision, and it put them in
fantastic moods.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With this, New Year's Day draws to a
close and
Kitasan Black boldly embarks
on her journey to
take on the Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
A winter swimming competition! Okay,
then let's
have our battle in the pool! I
won't lose to you,
Dia!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, they dive right into their
swimming
competition...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that was a good swim! It was pretty

interesting how we both used different
strokes,
huh, Dia?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It was. I prefer using the front crawl and

backstroke.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
And I'm better at breaststroke and
butterfly. I
guess I'm pretty good at
Uma-paddling too.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hey, since we're here in the pool and
everything,
why don't we teach each
other our specialty
strokes?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Good idea! I always wanted to learn the

Uma-paddle!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just as their upbringings differ, so to do
their
swimming styles. By teaching each
other, they
learn how to use their bodies
in new and different
ways.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With this, New Year's Day draws to a
close and
Kitasan Black boldly embarks
on her journey to
take on the Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
A New Year's hike? I guess we're trail
running,
then.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that sounds interesting. All right,
seeing as
it's the New Year, let's try
going up a mountain
we can't usually
climb!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, they choose a mountain to
tackle...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, running on a snowy mountain is
tough. I
won't lose to you, though!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You're right. The way you use your legs
is
completely different to usual, isn't it?
This is
probably even better training
than incline
running!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Running together on a snowy mountain
in winter
allows them to glean new
methods on how to
improve their
running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With this, New Year's Day draws to a
close and
Kitasan Black boldly embarks
on her journey to
take on the Osaka Hai.
